description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sandstorm Salvager, adding {C}{C}.
When Sandstorm Salvager dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sandstorm Salvager from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sandstorm Salvager enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
